prompt:
A peaceful five-pose ceremonial movement / animation reference board for Sylphiette, an ADULT holy priestess character in compact stylized nonpixel hand-painted anime game proportions. Reference 1 is her exact NEW normal costume, silver-white softly wavy hair, blue eyes, modest white-gold cloud-trimmed robe, sapphire waist clasp, small white flat shoes and small gold cloud-orb staff. Reference 2 supplies shared compact approximately 2.7-heads-tall body and soft cel-painted rendering only. Keep her exact same head/face/body construction in every panel; no hood or crown in this normal outfit.
Draw exactly FIVE numbered full-body key poses on WHITE, 1536x1024 landscape sheet: three poses on top row and two below, each has a stable common baseline within its row, complete head and staff with generous margins. View all figures from same LEFT-FACING side/three-quarter angle. These poses are a continuous elegant prayer-gesture sequence, no opposing person or target, no impacts, no harm. Staff remains in anatomical RIGHT hand for all five poses; anatomical LEFT hand does the open-palm gestures. Keep the trunk vertically stable, feet planted without bouncing, gentle restrained posture.
1. A small right-wrist forward tap of upright staff, left palm rests at chest height as if gathering a small point of warm light. This is the opening cue.
2. Following the previous wrist arc, right hand takes the staff to a restrained diagonal forward-left angle, while LEFT palm opens outward to guide the point of light. Clear hand shape and sleeve overlap.
3. Right hand draws staff back to body centerline upright; LEFT hand curves inward in a compact half-circle prayer gesture. Distinct transition of arms, no exaggerated hip turn.
4. Calm stable stance, right hand steadies staff at body center while LEFT open hand extends to shape a small simple geometric prayer seal in front. Subtle thin seal outline only, not a giant beam or fan of lights. Both arms arranged coherently while right hand still grips staff.
5. After the raised-staff cue, right hand finishes a deliberate short forward-and-down settling motion with staff held slightly forward, LEFT palm pushes outward clearly, then ready to return. A small single luminous seal at palm is optional. This sequence is dignified light-guiding magic, NOT rapid repeated identical wand flicks and NOT three-projectile fan shots.
Show five distinct but connected arm positions, same anatomy, hair, face, robe and staff. No loose staff floating away from hand, no extra limbs, no multi-panel head-size changes. No large magic effects masking the motion, no environment, no wings, no added creatures, no pixel art or realistic tall proportions, no camera angle changes. Labels only 1-5. This is a DESIGN GUIDE, not a finished runtime frame sheet.
